[[File:Rebel_Prison_Trooper.jpg|thumb|250px|A Rebel Prison Trooper guarding a Rebel detention facility.]]
'''Rebel Prison Troopers''' were specialized troops of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These troopers wore full body [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]-styled [[Crusader Mark II armor]]s and were armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster weapons]]. They worked with [[DZ-70 fugitive tracker droid|tracker droids]] and [[Prison Battle Droid|battle droids]].<ref name="SWG:RtfIO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Rescue the fourth Imperial Officer|Corellia}}</ref>

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Rebel Prison Troopers guarded a detention facility located in the [[Hidden Rebel Base|hidden Rebel Alliance base]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> after the base was discovered by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent sent by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, at least four Prison Troopers were killed during the Imperial assault of the detention facility.<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rebel Desert Troopers were [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Desert Troopers were added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and were present in the game during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events of 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref> One of the quests of this event sent Imperial players to the Rebel prison on Corellia where they had to kill various Rebel NPCs, including four Prison Troopers.<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" />
